units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|The <ship> settles down in one of the metal bubbles of the <planet> spaceport and before long, as the ground crew is unloading your ship's cargo, a pair of House Myurej's soldiers comes to lead you through the facility. They take you to an elevator outside of the spaceport's public area; you step in, and a few seconds after it begins moving, it clears the bulk of the spaceport complex and shows you a fantastic view of the planet's ocean as it descends deeper into the water. Unfortunately you're on the wrong side of the planet to see the bioluminscent algal streams of the "Ribbons of Iret," but even the relatively dark sea is impressive in its scale and in the vastness of the underwater infrastructure the Successors have built within it.|494|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Eventually the elevator nestles into a complex on the seafloor, and the two guards guide you through a number of transparent halls to a large central area. Fish swim above you, schooling behind a circular oculus. Another Successor approaches from one of the side corridors, and it is immediately apparent that this is one of Myurej's scions - they are draped in enough red gold and jewels that it's a wonder they can hold their body upright. When they speak, it's not the voice you heard behind the waving screen before, but one that's smoother and more inquisitive.|495|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Captain, captain," they say, "thou, Captain, who hast brought us such lovely glitterings with such fine loyalty. And through such perilous straits, I hear as well? The knave Riiria, the fearsome guardians of the Shroud... I could not bear to keep myself from seeing thee in the flesh, the flesh that holds all this surpassing strength!" Their adornments rattle as they gesture, prodding the air gently.|496|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Quite so!" the scion says. "They say a - what is it - a 'biped fever' runs through the people since thou arriv'st, that all at once all the worlds clamor for stories of artful, noble humans in the heyday of our Predecessors. I did not see the appeal at first, but by thy actions and seeing thee now... there's a certain strange elegance to the few arms, thine incomplete symmetry." They hum briefly. "But forgive me, that's not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in a fluid motion. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. I'm a cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."|506|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	The scion extends a gilded arm, shaking the myriad piercings and bits of jewelry upon it as if to contemplate them. "Oh, thou think'st me materialistic, mayhaps? Yet precious things are only made precious by the pain of acquiring them. The jewels thou didst bring back from the Shroud have already earned their own stories... as the beginning of a grand project of restoration, maybe, and at least as something totally unique." They hum with satisfaction. "And yet, 'tis not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in acknowledgment. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. A cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."|509|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Khiajsore hums again. It almost sounds like a piece of music; nothing you're familiar with, of course. "Myurej, Myurej, Myurej," they say. "For the rest here, Myurej is the state, but for those of us within it, Myurej is family. Were we the ones making up this crisis, I surely wouldn't tell thee, discreet as thou mayst have proven thyself." Jovial pastels color the scion's gilded body. "Soon enough, we the Houses shall promise thee all sorts of trinkets - ships and technologies - as our inhibitions fade in this ongoing disorder. Our judgment will be turned to new aims."|527|0

units.raw: `	Khiajsore hums again. It almost sounds like a piece of music; nothing you're familiar with, of course. "Myurej, Myurej, Myurej," they say. "For the rest here, Myurej is the state, but for those of us within it, Myurej is family. Were we the ones making up this crisis, I surely wouldn't tell thee, discreet as thou mayst have proven thyself." Jovial pastels color the scion's gilded body. "Soon enough, we the Houses shall promise thee all sorts of trinkets - ships and technologies - as our inhibitions fade in this ongoing disorder. Our judgment will be turned to new aims."`

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Khiajsore stops in a circular room where the flowers have spread out to colonize the space, dusting the air and water alike with their bright pollen. "I wish to invite thee to our wedding, Captain. Not mine!" they chuckle, "but Myurej's. 'Twill take place here, beneath the waves, as our kind once began in eons past. And it shall be a gathering of the Houses, of everyone of import. If thou hast made allies of others, as thou hast of us, there would be the place to petition thy case to all assembled. And," they add with a bright tone, "I do hope thou wilt enjoy the show."|529|0

The golden bloom rotates to face you as you take it from them, opening wide to reveal its bright interior. "Farewell now." they say, "The complex here shall meet thy needs, if thou requirest rest or aught else before thou must depart. May next we meet be as delightful as today, Captain."
